description: Traffic Volumes from SCATS Traffic Management System Jul-Dec DCC is a series of datasets listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. Traffic volumes data across Dublin City from the SCATS traffic management system. The Sydney Coordinated Adaptive Traffic System (SCATS) is an intelligent transportation system used to manage timing of signal phases at traffic signals. Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal lists 6 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are SCATS, detector, roads-highways, roads-traffic, traffic. It offers 2 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
